primary.description: Indigo color used for active states, link interactions, tabs, and primary action buttons.

primary_light.description: Light Indigo used for subheadings and hover state borders.

secondary.description: Vibrant Blue used for secondary buttons and info alerts.

accent.description: Emerald Green used for success, paid states, approved balances, and growth graphs.

warning.description: Amber color used for pending payouts, holding balances, and warning badges.

danger.description: Crimson used for delete actions, rejections, suspensions, and error states.

background.description: Base dark background color of the platform viewport body.

surface.description: Surface Card color, used for dashboard panels and settings sections.

surface_nested.description: Surface level 2, used for inner modal overlays, nested lists, and table headers.

border.description: Standard border line styling for cards, grids, and divider rules.
